row.title: PR 2276 carried onto main inside PR 2369: clean room and coherence kept, its system definition left out
row.body: Carried from PR 2276: CLEANROOM-1 (foundation/cleanroom.py, doctrine/cleanroom.json, cleanroom.yml, platform/selfhost/day.mjs, ops/cleanroom, loop, clock and flow rows, tests), COHERENCE-1 (foundation/coherence.py, doctrine/coherence.json: contradiction lint over instruction surfaces and generated satellite agent files, duplicates, rule reach, enforcement), the contract wording in workers/agents/CONTRACT.md and sync_agent_files.py, the hosted-boot facts in seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py and the HALT guard on four seed workflows. Left out as superseded: SYSTEM-1 (seed/doctrine/system.json and its SYSTEM.md) by SYSTEM-SPEC-1 and COLDSTART-1; BRANCH-CLEANUP-1 by REPO-STANDARD-1; the org-settings generator by ADMIT-1 and REPO-STANDARD-1; the seed-template remote compare and OL-20261125-2 by FLEET-MAP-1 (fleetmap --drift, template-publish.yml); seed/doctrine/balance.json by seed/autonomy/balance.json; seed/worker/src/stepplan.js by stepPlan in seed/worker/src/tick.js; seed/NOTICE by TEMPLATE-CODE-ONLY-1. The first clean-room run here found that a booted system's SYSTEM.md went stale (org/ paths counted as kit enforcement); seed/scripts/system.py no longer counts them, and cleanroom --run then ran 20 capabilities and 144 ticks and passes.
